hero.filename: Loughrea St. Brendan's Cathedral Baptistry Window Simeon by Michael Healy Detail 2019 09 05.jpg
hero.caption: Detail of the stained glass window in the baptistry by Michael Healy (1873–1941), depicting Simeon holding Jesus Christ. This work was created in 1904 in the An Túr Gloine workshop in Dublin. (See Nicola Gordon Bowe et al, Gazetteer of Irish Stained Glass, ISBN 0-7165-2413-9, p. 57; St Brendan's Cathedral, Loughrea, ISBN 0-900346-76-0.)
hero.alt: Detail of the stained glass window in the baptistry by Michael Healy (1873–1941), depicting Simeon holding Jesus Christ.
